speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har
text: asked the Minister for Education whether the Ministry will consider allowing Universities and schools to return to more normalised face-to-face activities and classes when TraceTogether tokens are in widespread use with safe distancing measures in place.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We now have effective Safe Management Measures in place in our schools and IHLs, coupled with a system of rapid contact tracing.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We have also improved capabilities to detect community cases quickly through our expanded testing regime and are exploring the monitoring of wastewater in student hostels.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: MOE is working through the details and will share more in due course.
